name: orkeon
description: AI agent teams that stay inside the lines, in .NET: every file, endpoint and budget an agent may touch is declared, then enforced. Describe a crew in YAML, TypeScript (.ork.ts) or C# — one runtime executes all three. Cloud and local LLMs, a staged RAG pipeline, and a virtual file system every tool goes through.

paragraphs: AI agent teams that stay inside the lines — every file, endpoint and budget an agent may touch is declared, then enforced. Described in YAML, TypeScript (.ork.ts) or C#; one .NET runtime executes all three.
features: Every number below is recomputed from the tree on each CI run — bash scripts/count-surface.sh prints them next to the rule that counts them, and a README that disagrees fails the build.

Three authoring surfaces, one engine — the same crew can be a YAML file an analyst edits, a TypeScript script a developer iterates on (both run with zero rebuild), or C# embedded in your product. No rewrite when you…

Orchestration beyond pipelines — six strategies, including a graph mode backed by a LangGraph-style StateGraph engine (conditional edges and controlled cycles in its C# API) and an autonomous mode where a manager…
Batteries included — 91 tools, 16 LLM providers, 6 memory stores, vision, RAG, code analysis: usable out of the box, replaceable through Clean Architecture ports.
Local-first — every example runs against a model on your own machine (Docker Model Runner, Ollama, or llama.cpp embedded in the container image). No API key required to evaluate it.
